description: FX2-SC raw-stream sidecar candidate adding a bounded XML timestamp position/class context to the current byte-split/direct/extra/page-match sidecar backend.
deps: C++ runtime for the bundled cmix/fx2 binary
basis: Tests whether decoder-recomputed timestamp position and expected character class reduce archive bytes enough to pay for the added predictor state and counted binary size. The primary byte stream is preserved exactly.
